ns2:course.label: Concepts and Tools of Genomics
ns2:course.description: An overview of genomics in the context of molecular biology including: basic principles in molecular biology, accessing biological databases; transcriptional, translational, and post-translational gene regulation; regulatory roles of non-protein coding RNA, signal transduction, genome projects and gene annotation, DNA microarray analysis, protein interaction maps, and integrative functional genomics. Prerequisite: CPSC 352 (Plant and Animal Genetics) or a similar course, or consent of instructor.
